title: Applicant groups a student can say they belong to, and which groups contain which
description: The fee-status choices the subject checker offers, in order, and the containment the eligibility engine needs to read them. A Nordic citizen is also an EU/EEA citizen, so a rule written for 'eu-eea-ch' applies to them — declared here rather than written into the engine, which names no group and no country. Group ids are the applicantGroup values in schemas/common.schema.json. A group with an `adjective` that sits within the reader's group is also read by scripts/test-audience.mjs, which refuses "as a <adjective> citizen, you …" stated as the reader's own case.

groups.label: Nordic citizen (Danish, Finnish, Icelandic, Norwegian or Swedish)
